subject: Possible to remove extra space at ends of axes?

messages.author: 2974c1dd08b9969a
messages.subject: Possible to remove extra space at ends of axes?
parts:
By default, ggvis expands the axes at either end by some factor.  When doing a stacked area chart that adds up to 100%, this can be very distracting as there will be a non-filled area around all sides.

In ggplot2, you can override this behavior by setting expand(0,0) in the axis properties.  Is this possible with ggvis directly?  Is there a viable workaround?

Thank you,
Jordan
